terminal.StandStones1.desc:
Book of Shadows, Notes on the NCE

The New Corporate Ethics (NCE) make it extremely difficult to advance the truths of our Religion throughout the Solar System. The Hexarchs assumed responsibility for regulating the ethical, not merely the political. Ultimately, the chimera of "freedom of conscience" found its way into the NCE. This allows rogues like the Church of Revelation to continue clouding the minds of the masses striving for the spiritual realm with the sly promises of a false "single god." Of course, the Sunlight Coven acknowledges the Hexarchs' contribution to the Great Anarchist Revolution. Of course, they had the moral authority to establish an anarchist order. But too much time has passed since then. The NCE must be an open document, amendable by all corporations. Our revolution was anarchist—its gains should be utilized to the very full.
terminal.StandStones2.desc:
Book of Shadows, Notes on the Hexarchy

Do not deceive yourself with division by three. The Rule of Three is sacred. The Rule of Three is absolute. The Hexarchy is not a perfect source of the political for the Solar System merely because six is perfectly divisible by three. Even a heptarchy—the rule of seven—would have been a better solution, matching the number of rays on the sacred star of the mages. We need an ennearchy. The rule of nine. The number nine is absolutely sacred, as it is three times three. The Rule of Three is perfectly refracted in the number nine.
Let us consider the worthy. RealWare is absolutely worthy—they are the guardians at the frontiers of absolute freedom of expression. AnCom is particularly worthy—we consider them to be our lost brothers. Dilthey is worthy enough—they are wise guides of people into the future. SBN is historically worthy—they help spread the words of Truth across the System. The worthiness of Tianming seems doubtful, but has been earned. As for the sixth organizer of the AnCap system, its worthiness is beyond any doubt, so much so that it doesn't even make sense to mention it here.
All this means that we could not only expand the hexarchy to an ennearchy and enter it ourselves, but also free one seat from the unworthy.

Note by Lady Domina. Saint Blavatsky wrote: "If the number six was the symbol of our planet made ready to receive the divine Spirit, then nine was the symbol of our Earth animated by the evil, or the Spirit of Darkness." We must preserve the Hexarchy. It must lead to the birth of something new and important.
terminal.StandStones3.desc:
Book of Shadows, Notes on Anarchism

Anarchy is not chaos, as the enslaved minds of those who wish to return the state yoke to their necks whisper. Anarchy is the natural pulse of an untouched forest, where there is no king, only the sacred balance of life and death. It is the embodiment of our Great Rule: "An it harm none, do what ye will." Absolute freedom, forged from personal responsibility and a deep connection to the Earth—that is what anarchy is. In a world without chains imposed by the state, we can finally hear the whispers of the Ancients and live in true harmony, where every soul is sovereign, every circle is autonomous, and all our strength flows from within, not from beneath a master's boot.
terminal.StandStones4.desc:
The Book of Shadows: Notes on Metaphysics

Theology should be left to the Church of Revelation. They believe that the subject of that false science—the Theos—actually exists. They are mistaken. The founding discipline of the Sunlight Coven must not be theology, but metaphysics. We study the world as it truly is. It takes only a clear gaze and an open heart to see what is evident: the world has never been one. There was never a "single god" who, by will or by error, brought creation into being. The world has always been plural, filled with many gods. Some are more powerful than others, yet all are willing to aid humankind, if only asked rightly and with due reverence. And among the gods there is, of course, a life-bearing principle, one that may awaken and come to humankind with gifts of vitality, freedom, and creative fire. We await and welcome this god. We shall do everything in our power to awaken it, or even bring it into being, should it not yet exist.
terminal.StandStones5.desc:
Revelations of Domina, Text-012

Our opponents call the worldview of the Sunlight Coven "chemical individualism." So be it. We believe that through initiation into truth, a person can become more than human. That is why we value the work of Daydream Chem.
I value it.
A person must be an individual. A person must be themselves—hence, individualism. The Sunlight Coven believes in hyper-individualism. We despise the Civil Resistance.
The pursuit of collective consciousness is the highest form of hyper-individualism. It is simple: to love oneself is to desire unbounded self-development. And what greater self-development could there be than the becoming of the hyper-individual? Begin gathering intelligence on the Hellstrom chip... We must transform humankind into the Singular.
terminal.StandStones6.desc:
Revelations of Domina, Text-667

Savage hordes of the living dead, reveling in the capitals fallen to the Unstoppable Evil—that's not the fictions of the timid, it is the true ideal of anarchy. Is this not what we seek? Is this not what we desire? "An it harm none, do what ye will." Killing is forbidden. But what if the dead have risen of their own accord? Then the feast must go on. Fill the chalices with blood.
terminal.tutorial0.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Recruit</color>, welcome to <color=#FFFEC1>Rogue City</color>! This station was the tool of thieving vampires, sucking the juices from the free people of the <color=#FFFEC1>Solar System</color>. It is now turned to the benefit of the working people. You made the right choice when you decided to leave your employer and then get to the nearest <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> base by any means necessary. No more corporate slavery! You will go through reintegration into organized society. Soon you will become a <color=#FFFEC1>citizen</color> again. Right now you need to go to the training classroom, where you will gradually start to learn what it means to become a full member of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. I welcome you and thank you for making the right choice. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>.
terminal.tutorial1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>, you need to start showing results in the <color=#FFFEC1>Inner System</color> as soon as possible. You are conducting open combat operations, sacrificing many of our <color=#FFFEC1>colnodes</color> that could be useful to us on <color=#FFFEC1>Saturn</color> or in our business at transneptunian sites. You promised to strike a sensitive blow to <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color>, but you haven’t done that. You promised to reveal the truth about <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color>, but you only have a theory that may well be incorrect. You must conduct an immediate review of the rational use of resources in your sector. <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color>.
terminal.tutorial2.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Rogue City</color> is secure enough to prepare messages for routing into the <color=#FFFEC1>External System</color>. I have successfully infiltrated <color=#FFFEC1>L-BSA</color> as a security guard. Some time ago, there was an attack here by the <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Magnum</color> to extract some important prisoner. I managed to establish that the <color=#FFFEC1>HIS</color> acted as contractors for <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color>. The chances that my theory is correct have sharply increased. <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> is more than just a publisher. Unfortunately, <color=#FFFEC1>L-BSA</color> is now open to attack, and its owners will change. I'm not sure if I can continue to provide relevant information. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>.
terminal.tutorial3.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>, your demand for more <color=#FFFEC1>colnodes</color> is outrageous. You work within the <color=#FFFEC1>Inner System</color>. You have <color=#FFFEC1>Mars</color> at your disposal! You need to manage with the resources available and focus on recruitment. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>, your recent behavior is causing concern. Perhaps too many <color=#FFFEC1>colnodes</color> can lead to the disintegration of a <color=#FFFEC1>personality</color>. We will conduct the appropriate research. Remember that the social must always prevail over the personal. <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color>.
terminal.tutorial4.desc: The number of <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> counter-intelligence agents on the streets of <color=#FFFEC1>InterCity</color> is extremely high. My <color=#FFFEC1>colnodes</color> are constantly at risk of being exposed. From now on, I'm going to keep one bullet in <color=#FFFEC1>Liberator</color> for myself. The risk of our secrets falling into the hands of <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> is not justified. Especially since this is not our priority target in the <color=#FFFEC1>Inner System</color>. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>.
